// Test fixture: unchanged lesson runtime from the user-provided EIU Interactive JS 1.2.1 ZIP.
/* One sandbox and one module evaluation per lesson; navigation uses a private port. */
function lessonFrameBootstrap() {
 'use strict';
 const root=document.getElementById('root'),Fragment=Symbol('Fragment');
 const svgTags=new Set(['svg','path','circle','rect','line','polyline','polygon','g','text','defs','linearGradient','stop','foreignObject']);
 const append=(parent,value)=>{if(value==null||value===false||value===true)return;if(Array.isArray(value)){value.forEach(v=>append(parent,v));return;}if(value instanceof Node){parent.appendChild(value);return;}parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(String(value)));};
 const h=(type,props,...children)=>{
  props=props||{};if(type===Fragment)return children;if(typeof type==='function')return type({...props,children});
  const el=svgTags.has(type)?document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',type):document.createElement(type);
  Object.entries(props).forEach(([key,value])=>{if(key==='children'||value==null)return;if(key==='className'){el.setAttribute('class',String(value));return;}if(key==='style'&&typeof value==='object'){Object.assign(el.style,value);return;}if(key==='dangerouslySetInnerHTML')return;if(/^on[A-Z]/.test(key)&&typeof value==='function'){el.addEventListener(key.slice(2).toLowerCase(),value);return;}const attr=key==='htmlFor'?'for':key;try{if(el.namespaceURI==='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg')el.setAttribute(attr,String(value));else if(attr in el&&typeof value!=='object')el[attr]=value;else el.setAttribute(attr,String(value));}catch{el.setAttribute(attr,String(value));}});
  append(el,children);return el;
 };
 const React={createElement:h,Fragment},cache=new Map(),cacheLimit=6;
 let port,slides=[],active=null,template='',useTemplate=true,evaluations=0;
 const emit=payload=>port.postMessage(payload);
 function present(page,sequence=0){
  const start=performance.now();if(!Number.isSafeInteger(page)||page<1||page>slides.length)return;
  try{
   let entry=cache.get(page);const hit=Boolean(entry);
   if(!entry){
    const fragment=document.createDocumentFragment(),slide=slides[page-1];
    append(fragment,(typeof slide==='function'?slide():slide)??h('div',{id:'error'},'Slide is empty.'));
    const preserve=Boolean(fragment.querySelector('[data-eiu-template="eiu-business-v1"],[data-preserve-original="true"]'));
    const content=document.createElement('div');content.className='eiu-content';content.append(fragment);
    const number=document.createElement('span');number.className='eiu-number';number.textContent=String(page);
    entry={content,number,preserve};
   }
   root.replaceChildren(entry.content,entry.number);active={page,...entry};
   cache.delete(page);cache.set(page,entry);while(cache.size>cacheLimit)cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
   applyTemplate();
   emit({type:'shown',page,sequence,cacheHit:hit,renderMs:performance.now()-start,cacheSize:cache.size,evaluations});
  }catch(error){emit({type:'render-error',sequence,message:String(error.message||error)});}
 }
 function applyTemplate(){
  const apply=Boolean(active&&useTemplate&&template&&!active.preserve);
  root.classList.toggle('eiu-template',apply);root.style.backgroundImage=apply?'url('+JSON.stringify(template)+')':'';
 }
 document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
  if(event.defaultPrevented||event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey||event.altKey||event.shiftKey)return;
  if(event.key==='Escape'&&!document.querySelector('[aria-modal="true"]')){emit({type:'exit-presentation'});return;}
  if(event.target?.closest?.('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"],[role="dialog"]')||document.querySelector('[aria-modal="true"]'))return;
  const delta=['ArrowRight','PageDown'].includes(event.key)?1:['ArrowLeft','PageUp'].includes(event.key)?-1:0;
  if(delta){event.preventDefault();emit({type:'navigate',delta});}
 });
 window.addEventListener('message',function connect(event){
  if(event.source!==parent||event.data?.type!=='eiu-connect'||!event.ports[0])return;
  window.removeEventListener('message',connect);port=event.ports[0];
  port.onmessage=event=>{
   const message=event.data;
   if(message.type==='init'){
    if(evaluations)return;
    try{
     const start=performance.now(),module={exports:{}};evaluations++;
     new Function('module','exports','h','Fragment','React',message.code)(module,module.exports,h,Fragment,React);
     let candidate=module.exports.default??module.exports.slides??module.exports;if(typeof candidate==='function')candidate=candidate();
     slides=Array.isArray(candidate)?candidate:[candidate];if(!slides.length||slides.length>10000)throw Error('Bài học không chứa slide hợp lệ.');
     template=message.template||'';useTemplate=message.useTemplate!==false;
     emit({type:'loaded',total:slides.length,loadMs:performance.now()-start});present(1,message.sequence);
    }catch(error){emit({type:'load-error',message:String(error.message||error)});}
   }else if(message.type==='show')present(message.page,message.sequence);
   else if(message.type==='template'){useTemplate=message.enabled;applyTemplate();}
  };port.start();
 });
}
function createLessonDocument(){
 return `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; font-src data:"><style>
 *{box-sizing:border-box}html,body,#root{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden}body{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#082945}
 .eiu-content,.eiu-content>*,.slide{width:100%;height:100%}button,a,[role=button]{cursor:pointer}
 #root{position:relative;background-position:center;background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat}.eiu-number{display:none}
 #root.eiu-template>.eiu-content{position:absolute;left:5.6%;top:11.5%;width:88.8%;height:77.4%;overflow:hidden;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#144069}
 #root.eiu-template>.eiu-number{position:absolute;left:93.711%;top:95.152%;width:2.664%;height:4.736%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 .9vw Arial;color:#144069}
 #error{padding:32px;white-space:pre-wrap;color:#8b1e1e;font:14px/1.5 Consolas,monospace}
 </style></head><body><div id="root"></div><script>(${lessonFrameBootstrap.toString()})();<\/script></body></html>`;
}
